name: Split by invoice number
prompt: Split this batch so each invoice is one part. Use the invoice number as the part title.

name: Split by vendor
prompt: Split this batch so all pages from the same vendor form one part. Use the vendor name as the part title.

name: Split by agreement
prompt: Split this bundle so each separate agreement is one part. Use the agreement title as the part title.

name: Separate exhibits and schedules
prompt: Split the main agreement from each exhibit, schedule and annex. Use the exhibit or schedule name as the part title.

name: Split by account
prompt: Split so each bank account is one part. Use the account name or last four digits as the part title.

name: Split by month
prompt: Split so each statement period (month) is one part. Use the month and year as the part title.

name: Split course material by chapter
prompt: Split this course material so each chapter is one part. Use chapter titles as part titles.

name: Split exams by student
prompt: Split these exam scripts so each student is one part. Use the student name or ID as the part title.

name: Split notes by topic
prompt: Split these notes so each topic is one part. Use the topic heading as the part title.

name: Separate answer sheets from question sheets
prompt: Split so question sheets and answer sheets are separate parts. Title each part Questions or Answers.

name: Split by patient
prompt: Split these records so each patient is one part. Use the patient name or record number as the part title.

name: Split by visit date
prompt: Split these records so each visit is one part. Use the visit date as the part title.

name: Split by employee
prompt: Split so each employee is one part. Use the employee name or ID as the part title.

name: Split by policy or claim
prompt: Split so each policy or claim is one part. Use the policy or claim number as the part title.

name: Split by shipment or bill of lading
prompt: Split so each shipment or bill of lading is one part. Use the B/L or shipment number as the part title.

name: Split by form type or applicant
prompt: Split so each form is one part. Use the form type and applicant name as the part title.

name: Split at blank pages
prompt: Split this scanned batch where a new document begins. Blank pages usually separate documents.

name: Split by section or campaign
prompt: Split so each section or campaign is one part. Use the section or campaign name as the part title.

name: Split by chapter or part
prompt: Split this book so each chapter is one part. Use chapter titles as part titles.
